exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures of food and drinks.
exercises.explanationUz:
6-UNIT LUG'ATI - OVQAT.

  ⚠ Betdagi HAMMA yorliq - keyingi
  mashqlarda kerak bo'ladi.


⚠ SANALADIGAN va SANALMAYDIGAN:

  SANALADIGAN (ko'plikda '-s'):
     peaches, mushrooms, nuts,
     prawns, mussels, sandwiches,
     bread rolls

  SANALMAYDIGAN:
     bread, rice, juice, oil,
     vinegar, chicken (go'sht
     sifatida), lettuce

  ⚠ 'a chicken' = tirik tovuq,
  'chicken' = tovuq go'shti.


⚠ FAQAT KO'PLIKDAGI OVQATLAR:

  peas, green beans, brussels
  sprouts, chips, mussels, prawns,
  nuts


⚠ 'CHIPS' - IKKI XIL MA'NO:

  Britaniyada 'chips' = kartoshka
     fri (yumshoq, yo'g'on)
  AQShda 'chips' = kartoshka
     chipsi (yupqa, quruq)

  ⚠ Britaniyada chips uchun 'crisps'
  deyiladi!


⚠ 'A JACKET POTATO':

  = po'sti bilan pishirilgan
  kartoshka.
  ⚠ 'a baked potato' ham deyiladi.


⚠ 'WHOLEMEAL BREAD':

  = to'liq donli non.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'wholemeal',
  AQShda 'whole wheat'.


⚠ 'FRESHLY-SQUEEZED':

  = yangi siqilgan.
  ⚠ 'to squeeze' = siqmoq.
  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (ravish + sifat).


⚠ 'A DOUGHNUT':

  ⚠ Britaniyada 'doughnut',
  AQShda 'donut'.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈdəʊnʌt/ - 'gh'
  O'QILMAYDI.


⚠ 'YOGHURT':

  ⚠ Britaniyada 'yoghurt' yoki
  'yogurt', AQShda 'yogurt'.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈjɒɡət/.


⚠ 'BRUSSELS SPROUTS':

  = Bryussel karami.
  ⚠ 'Brussels' - KATTA harf (shahar
  nomi).


⚠ 'SPAGHETTI BOLOGNESE':

  ⚠ 'spaghetti' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  BIRLIK fe'l bilan:
  'Spaghetti IS my favourite.'

grilled chicken, Basmati rice, brussels sprouts, carrots

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures of food and drinks. Which are: healthy, low-fat foods; fatty foods; junk food?
exercises.instructionUz: Ovqat va ichimliklar suratlariga qarang. Qaysilari: sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqatlar; yog'li ovqatlar; foydasiz ovqat?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh TOIFA.


⚠ 'HEALTHY, LOW-FAT FOODS':

  = sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqatlar.
  Betdan: melon, cucumber,
  watermelon, mushrooms, peaches,
  carrot juice, apple juice,
  lettuce, fruit salad, green beans,
  peas, prawns, mussels, yoghurt
  (low fat), grilled chicken,
  wholemeal bread, broccoli


⚠ 'FATTY FOODS':

  = yog'li ovqatlar.
  Betdan: fried chicken, sausages,
  bacon, chocolate cake, doughnut,
  nuts, olive oil, French toast,
  garlic bread


⚠ 'JUNK FOOD':

  = foydasiz, tez tayyor ovqat.
  Betdan: club sandwich with chips,
  doughnut, bacon & cheese sandwich


⚠ 'FOOD' - SANALMAYDIGAN:

  ⚠ 'Food IS expensive.' (BIRLIK
  fe'l)
  ⚠ Lekin 'foods' = turli xil
  ovqatlar (turlar haqida
  gapirganda) - mashqda ham shunday.


⚠ 'JUNK':

  = axlat, keraksiz narsa.
  ⚠ 'junk food' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  'junk foods' XATO.


⚠ 'FATTY' va 'FAT':

  fat = semiz (odam) yoki yog' (ot)
  fatty = yog'li (ovqat)

  ⚠ 'a fat food' - XATO,
  'a fatty food' ✓


⚠ 'LOW-FAT':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (sifat vazifasida).
  ⚠ Aksi: 'full-fat' yoki 'high-fat'.

tasks.en: Which foods are healthy, low-fat foods?
tasks.uz: Qaysi ovqatlar sog'lom va kam yog'li?

exercises.instructionEn: What food & drink would be suitable for: a vegetarian; somebody who is on a diet?
exercises.instructionUz: Qanday ovqat va ichimlik mos keladi: vegetarianga; parhezdagi odamga?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'A VEGETARIAN':

  = go'sht yemaydigan odam.
  ⚠ Lekin tuxum, sut, pishloq yeydi.
  ⚠ 'a vegan' = umuman hayvon
  mahsulotlarini yemaydigan.


⚠ 'TO BE ON A DIET':

  = parhezda bo'lmoq (ozish uchun).
  ⚠ 'ON a diet' - 'on' predlogi
  ShART.
  ⚠ 'to go on a diet' = parhezga
  o'tirmoq.


⚠ 'A DIET' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) parhez (ozish uchun)
  2) ovqatlanish tarzi (umuman)
     'a healthy diet' = sog'lom
     ovqatlanish

  ⚠ 3c mashqida IKKINChI ma'noda.


⚠ 'SUITABLE FOR':

  = ... uchun mos.
  ⚠ 'suitable TO' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'to suit' = mos kelmoq.

tasks.en: What food & drink would be suitable for a vegetarian?
tasks.uz: Vegetarianga qanday ovqat va ichimlik mos keladi?

tasks.en: What food & drink would be suitable for somebody who is on a diet?
tasks.uz: Parhezdagi odamga qanday ovqat va ichimlik mos keladi?

exercises.instructionEn: a) What do you usually eat and drink: at work/school; on a picnic; at a fast-food restaurant; at an expensive restaurant? b) Do you often: eat junk food; have a snack between meals? c) Do you worry about how healthy your diet is? Are you a fussy eater? d) Which foods: contain a lot of calories; contain protein; are rich in vitamins?
exercises.instructionUz: a) Odatda nima yeb-ichasiz: ishda/maktabda; piknikda; tez ovqat restoranida; qimmat restoranda? b) Tez-tez: foydasiz ovqat yeysizmi; ovqatlar orasida tamaddi qilasizmi? c) Ovqatlanishingiz qanchalik sog'lomligidan xavotirdamisiz? Injiq yeguvchimisiz? d) Qaysi ovqatlarda: ko'p kaloriya bor; oqsil bor; vitaminlarga boy?
exercises.explanationUz:
SUHBAT SAVOLLARI.


⚠ 'AT WORK' va 'AT SCHOOL':

  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ! Chunki MAQSAD ko'zda
  tutilyapti (ishlash, o'qish).
  ⚠ 37-38-betlarda 'at university'
  ham shunday edi.


⚠ 'ON A PICNIC':

  ⚠ 'on' predlogi - 38-betdagi
  23-mashqda ham bor edi.


⚠ 'A FAST-FOOD RESTAURANT':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (sifat vazifasida).
  ⚠ 'fast food' (ot) - defissiz.


⚠ 'AN EXPENSIVE RESTAURANT':

  ⚠ 'AN' - chunki 'expensive' UNLI
  bilan boshlanadi.


⚠ 'A SNACK BETWEEN MEALS':

  = ovqatlar orasida yengil tamaddi.
  ⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish
  (nonushta, tushlik, kechki ovqat).
  ⚠ 36-betdagi 14-mashqda 'have a
  snack' bor edi.


⚠ 'A FUSSY EATER':

  = injiq yeguvchi (ko'p narsani
  yemaydigan).
  ⚠ 'fussy' = injiq, tanlab
  yeydigan.


⚠ 'TO CONTAIN':

  = o'z ichiga olmoq, tarkibida
  bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'to contain' - PREDLOGSIZ.


⚠ 'RICH IN':

  = ... ga boy.
  ⚠ 'rich IN vitamins' - 'in'
  predlogi ShART.
  ⚠ 'rich of' - XATO.


⚠ 'CALORIES', 'PROTEIN', 'VITAMINS':

  ⚠ 'a calorie' - SANALADIGAN.
  ⚠ 'protein' - SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'a vitamin' - SANALADIGAN.
  ⚠ 'vitamin' Britaniyada /ˈvɪtəmɪn/,
  AQShda /ˈvaɪtəmɪn/.

tasks.en: a) What do you usually eat and drink at work/school?
a) What do you usually eat and drink on a picnic?
a) What do you usually eat at a fast-food restaurant?
tasks.uz: a) Tez ovqat restoranida odatda nima yeysiz?

tasks.en: a) What do you usually eat at an expensive restaurant?
tasks.uz: a) Qimmat restoranda odatda nima yeysiz?

tasks.en: b) Do you often eat junk food or have a snack between meals?
tasks.uz: b) Tez-tez foydasiz ovqat yeysizmi yoki ovqatlar orasida tamaddi qilasizmi?

tasks.en: c) Do you worry about how healthy your diet is? Are you a fussy eater?
tasks.uz: c) Ovqatlanishingiz qanchalik sog'lomligidan xavotirdamisiz? Injiq yeguvchimisiz?

tasks.en: d) Which foods contain a lot of calories?
tasks.uz: d) Qaysi ovqatlarda ko'p kaloriya bor?

tasks.en: d) Which foods are rich in vitamins?

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and match the stars to the things they like to eat or drink.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va yulduzlarni ular yeyishni yoki ichishni yoqtiradigan narsalarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - kim nimani
yoqtirishini faqat yozuvni tinglab
bilish mumkin.


OLTI YuLDUZ:

  1 Demi Moore
  2 Helen Hunt
  3 Eddie Murphy
  4 Whoopi Goldberg
  5 Bill Murray
  6 Mickey Rourke


OLTI OVQAT:

  a bacon sandwiches
    - bekonli sendvichlar
  b fried chicken
    - qovurilgan tovuq
  c watermelon (without seeds)
    - tarvuz (urug'siz)
  d turkey sandwiches
    - kurka go'shtli sendvichlar
  e carrot juice
    - sabzi sharbati
  f poached eggs
    - qaynoq suvda pishirilgan tuxum


⚠ 'A STAR':

  = mashhur odam (kino, sport).
  ⚠ 'a film star', 'a pop star'.


⚠ 'A SEED':

  = urug', danak.
  ⚠ 'without seeds' = urug'siz.


⚠ 'A POACHED EGG':

  = qaynoq suvga po'stsiz solib
  pishirilgan tuxum.
  ⚠ Tuxum pishirish usullari:
     boiled - qaynatilgan (po'sti
        bilan)
     fried - qovurilgan
     scrambled - aralashtirilgan
     poached - suvda pishirilgan


⚠ 'TURKEY':

  = kurka (qush).
  ⚠ 'Turkey' KATTA harf bilan =
  Turkiya!


⚠ 'TO LIKE' + TO / -ING:

  'like to eat' va 'like eating' -
  ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
  ⚠ Britaniyada -ING ko'proq.

tasks.en: Listen and match the stars to the things they like to eat or drink.
tasks.uz: Tinglang va yulduzlarni ular yeyishni yoki ichishni yoqtiradigan narsalarga moslang.

tasks.note:
⚠ Audio kerak - qaysi ovqatga mosligini yozuv
aytadi.

⚠ 'to poach' = po'stsiz qaynoq suvda pishirmoq.
⚠ Boshqa usullar: boiled, fried, scrambled.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Betdagi ko'p ovqat nomi ikki otdan yasalgan.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Meva salati - sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqat.

At school I usually have a sandwich and some fruit juice.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Maktabda odatda sendvich va meva sharbati olaman.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Chocolate cake contains a lot of calories.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to contain' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ 'a lot of' - sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan
bilan ham.
